values.note: Reservations by phone (814-807-8005); a card holds the reservation. Memorial Day, 4th of July and Labor Day need three nights; the Haunted Halloween weekend needs two.

booking.source: https://oilcreekcampground.com/contact-us/ ('Call to make reservations') + https://oilcreekcampground.com/campsite-rates/ ('Memorial Day, 4th of July, Labor Day A minimum three night reservation'; 'Haunted Halloween A minimum two night reservation'), read 2026-10-20

note: Private family campground (54 wooded acres, ~97 sites) near Titusville (Crawford Co); set back from Oil Creek itself. Big-rig friendly pull-throughs, 20/30/50-amp, water/electric and full-hookup sites; 2026 season April 17-October 31. Not waterfront. RV Life 5★, price $$ (2/4). Reservations by phone only (814-807-8005); no online booking system. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 50-amp electric and pull-throughs; added water+sewer (2026 full-hookup $50), showers, dump, camp store, the 2026 season Apr 17-Oct 31, phone-only booking and the 3-night holiday minimum. Fees (2026 table $40 rustic / $45 W&E / $50 FHU) already recorded from the same page; left as recorded. Site count not stated on the operator's pages (left). Note: season corrected (Oct 31, not Nov 1) and the two --Claude sentences merged.
